connector.name: Warm
connector.registryDescription: Context and automation MCP server for Warm financial data and approved write operations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jasonstockman account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WARM_CONTEXT_API_KEY
env.description: Optional context API key. The local context key file is used when omitted.

env.name: WARM_CONTEXT_API_KEY_FILE
env.description: Optional path to the context API key file.

env.name: WARM_AUTOMATION_API_KEY
env.description: Optional automation API key. The local automation key file is used when omitted.

env.name: WARM_AUTOMATION_API_KEY_FILE
env.description: Optional path to the automation API key file.

env.name: WARM_CONFIG_DIR
env.description: Optional path to the Warm configuration directory.

env.name: WARM_API_URL
env.description: Optional Warm API base URL override. Defaults to https://app.warm.io.

env.name: WARM_API_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Optional request timeout override in milliseconds.
